signals.source_text: When Igigi workers began foundation excavation, the Giants would undo their work through consciousness-touch that demonstrated far greater sophistication than anything the Anunnaki's slaves could achieve.
Pazuzu—reassigned to this site after the northern mountain construction stalled—stood amid the carnage and calculated probabilities that his mathematical mind could barely process.
The question hung between them, unanswerable because any answer would require confronting truths that Pazuzu's logical mind had been avoiding for centuries.
A massive explosion of sand erupted across the construction site as a burnt-red Giant, larger than any Pazuzu had seen before, burst from an underground tunnel.
